app.name: PublishKit
app.subtitle: Content ops for cross-border marketing
nav.flowHint: Follow steps ①–⑥ to prepare and publish. Settings anytime.
today.title: Today
today.subtitle: Ready tasks due today or overdue. Upcoming schedules stay on Tasks or Calendar.
today.empty: Nothing to publish today. Check Tasks or Calendar for upcoming schedules.
tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.subtitle: Content × channel ledger. Each channel has its own status.
tasks.subtitleGrouped: Grouped by date. Overdue and older months collapse by default.
tasks.publishedDateHint: Defaults to the original schedule; change if you posted on a different day.
tasks.rescheduleHint: Stays ready; appears on Today only on the new date.
tasks.archiveHint: Drop this content × channel task from Today and the ready queue.
tasks.archiveConfirm: This task will leave Today and the ready queue. Archive it?
tasks.empty: No tasks yet. Use “Create task” on the Content page.
tasks.duplicatePublishConfirm: “{title}” on {channel} was marked published on {when} ({days} days ago). {detail}Mark as published again?
tasks.duplicatePublishNoUrl: No URL was saved last time.
tasks.scheduledDateHint: Leave empty for no date. Marking ready sets today if empty.
tasks.notePlaceholder: Compliance notes, UTM tags, internal memo…
tasks.blockedReasonPlaceholder: Enter or pick a block reason
sources.title: Sources
sources.formatsHint: Supports .md / .txt / .docx / .pdf / .html / .xlsx / .csv (including Feishu Word and spreadsheet exports). Save old .doc files as .docx.
batch.title: Schedule import
batch.subtitle: Split title, body, keywords, and images, then create ready tasks from a start date and interval.
batch.formatsHint: Select Markdown, Word, PDF, HTML, Excel, or CSV. If a sheet already has date, platform, or keyword columns, those columns are used.
batch.templateHint: Write pieces in the article template. Use the schedule sheet when a row already has a date or platform. Image names must already be in this project's image library. In Word, keep the same labels and save as .docx.
batch.pickImages: Several files share a name. Check the ones to attach.
batch.empty: These files have no body to schedule.
batch.intervalHint: Undated pieces start on the start date, then every this many days. 0 puts the selected pieces on the start date. Each selected platform gets its own task on that same date.
batch.addPlatformHint: Type a name and add it when your platform is not listed. It is selected for this import and kept in Settings.
batch.done: Added {content} item(s) and {tasks} ready task(s). Skipped {skipped} duplicate task(s).
channels.hashHint: This is the platform default. Copy keywords remembers the choice you just made. Stored words stay without a hash.
content.title: Content
content.subtitle: Imported items. Copy converts Markdown to rich text for publishing.
content.empty: No content items yet. Split Markdown or create one manually.
content.keywordsHint: Separate with commas. Leave the # off.
content.moved: Moved {count} item(s). Files stay where they are.
content.warnXhsTitle: Xiaohongshu titles are usually within 20 characters ({count})
content.warnPinTitle: Pinterest titles are usually within 100 characters ({count})
content.warnPinBody: Pinterest descriptions are usually within 500 characters ({count})
project.tabHint: Content and media follow the selected tab. Today and Calendar still list every project.
project.rootBound: This folder already belongs to "{name}". Attach it to the current project? Files are not moved.
content.createHint: For non-Markdown sources or ad-hoc copy you want to publish.
content.taskCreated: Created a {channel} task. Mark it ready on Tasks.
content.deleteConfirmOne: Delete “{title}”? Related tasks will be removed. Source Markdown files are not affected.
content.deleteConfirmMany: Delete {count} selected items? Related tasks will be removed. Source Markdown files are not affected.
split.title: Markdown split wizard
split.replaceExisting: Replace existing items from this file
split.metaHint: Instruction/meta sections are unchecked by default.
split.empty: No sections detected. Try another strategy or check the Markdown structure.
split.importDone: Imported {count} items. View them under Content.
tableImport.title: Table import wizard
tableImport.empty: No importable rows found. Check column headers or cell content.
media.title: Media
media.subtitle: Scan to build thumbnails; copy images to the clipboard and paste when posting.
media.scanDone: Processed {indexed} files this scan; {total} assets in library
media.empty: No media yet. Set a media folder under Sources, then scan here.
media.noRoot: Choose a media folder under Sources first.
media.linkEmpty: Media library is empty. Scan a folder on the Media page first.
media.copied: Image copied — paste it on the platform
media.stagedMultiple: Copied {count} images to a temp folder and opened it. Older temp folders are cleaned on the next copy.
media.copiedMultipleHint: Copied the first image ({count} linked — copy others from Media)
media.suggestEmpty: No suggestions yet. Try: (1) put images next to the Markdown file; (2) mirror copy/media folder structure and filenames; (3) include title keywords in filenames. Pick manually from “All assets” below.
calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.subtitle: Month view — click a day to see task details.
settings.title: Settings
settings.backupHint: Export a zip with the database and settings; optional thumbnail cache. Restore supports replace or merge.
settings.restoreConfirm: This replaces your database and settings, then restarts the app. A .pre-restore copy is saved first. Continue?
settings.restoreMergeConfirm: This merges new rows from the backup into your current library (keeps existing data; settings unchanged). Continue?
settings.extensionHint: The extension connects via localhost API. The base URL is for the extension (browser shows JSON info at /); paste the token into the extension popup.
settings.extensionTokenRotated: Token updated — save it again in the extension.
channels.title: Publishing platforms
channels.subtitle: Built-in domestic and overseas platforms; add custom labels.
onboarding.title: Welcome to PublishKit
onboarding.subtitle: Pick copy and media folders to start managing publish tasks.
onboarding.copyRootPlaceholder: Click Browse to choose your Markdown copy folder
onboarding.mediaRootPlaceholder: Click Browse to choose your image or video folder
onboarding.footerHint: You can change folders anytime in Settings.
inspector.noteHelp: Task notes live in the task action bar; this is item-level memo space.
calendar.exportHint: One row is one piece on one platform. The same piece on two platforms is two rows.
calendar.exportDateHint: The date matches the calendar: published tasks use the publish day, otherwise the scheduled day.
calendar.exportRangeInvalid: The start date has to be on or before the end date.
settings.scanIgnoreHint: One folder name per line; skipped when scanning (plus built-in node_modules, .git, etc.).
settings.videoRootHint: Separate from images; media scan indexes both folders.
settings.syncHint: Encrypted sync is a future Sync subscription feature.
